description: This file contains asynchronous service functions for task management within a project collaboration platform, using FastAPI and SQLAlchemy. It manages tasks, including creating, listing, updating, changing status, assigning, and deleting tasks, with access control based on project membership.

methods.name: Project _ensure_project_member(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Ensures a user is a member or owner of a specified project, returning the project if authorized.

methods.name: List[Task] list_tasks(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Lists non-archived tasks for a project if the user has access.

methods.name: Task create_task( db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, user_id: int, title: str, description: Optional[str], status_value: str, priority_value: str, due_date=None, assignee_id: Optional[int] = None, )
methods.description: Creates a new task within a project, validating project membership and optionally assignee.

methods.name: Task update_task(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, task_id: int, user_id: int, updates: dict)
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing task if the user has access to the project.

methods.name: Task change_status(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, task_id: int, user_id: int, status_value: str)
methods.description: Changes the status of a specified task.

methods.name: Task assign_task(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, task_id: int, user_id: int, assignee_id: int | None)
methods.description: Assigns or unassigns a task to a project member.

methods.name: None delete_task(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, task_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a task from a project if the user has access.
